name: RotatingIcons
description: A headline accent that rolls through icons on a 3D cube flip instead of words — a static prefix followed by a tiled icon that turns over on an interval.
a11yNotes: The animated icons are aria-hidden; a visually hidden sentence (prefix plus every icon's spoken label) gives screen readers the full meaning once instead of announcing each flip. The loop pauses when off-screen or the tab is hidden, and reduced motion shows the first icon without flipping.

controls.label: Icons (comma separated: scroll, shader, interface, sparkles, cursor, layers, code, palette, zap, globe)
